This '''mining facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] and was used by the planet's [[mining caste]]. In [[980 BBY]], when the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] came into conflict with the planet's [[Doan Royal House|Royal House]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]], was sent to negotiate between the two factions. Tandar met with the miners' leader, [[Gelba]]&mdash;along with two of Gelba's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] and three of her [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]]&mdash;in the facility, where they began to discuss negotiations. However, an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] suddenly arrived and [[Massacre on Doan|attacked]] them, quickly dispatching of the miners and then continuing on to kill Tandar as well.
